title: C: Multiplication Table
description: Print a multiplication table for numbers 1 through 10 using nested loops.

steps.title: Print Multiplication Table
steps.description: Use nested for loops to print a 10x10 multiplication table. Each cell shows the product of row number and column number. Use tabs between columns.
hints: Outer loop for rows (1-10), inner loop for columns (1-10).
Use `printf("%d\t", i * j);` for each cell.
